### Added
- **`spec.router.scheduler`: a serving preset switches the llm-d endpoint picker for itself** (giantswarm/agent-platform#507; epic giantswarm/giantswarm#37639). model-manager composes an `LLMInferenceService` without the picker unless the backend document's `spec.kserve.router.scheduler` says otherwise, and reads a preset's own `spec.router.scheduler` (`true` or `false`) over it. The preset schema now admits `spec.router` with `scheduler` alone, and the render refuses any other key under `spec.router` and a non-boolean `scheduler`, naming the preset. A preset that switches the picker on needs the Gateway API Inference Extension on the models Gateway (#504). No shipped preset sets it; the default render is unchanged. `make verify-serving-slice` publishes a values preset with `router.scheduler: true` unchanged and fails the render on the other shapes.
